description_en: By default, Resource Access Management (RAM) users or roles that are not cluster creators and have not been granted access permissions across all cluster dimensions do not have any RBAC permissions in a cluster. You can invoke the GrantPermissions operation to update the RBAC access permissions of a RAM user or role, including accessible resources, permission scope, and preset role types, to better manage cluster management security and access control
description_zh: 非集群创建者、没有被授予过所有集群维度权限的RAM用户或角色在集群中默认没有任何RBAC权限。您可以调用GrantPermissions接口，更新RAM用户或角色拥有的RBAC访问权限，包括可访问的资源、权限的作用范围、预置的角色类型等，从而更好地管理集群的安全访问控制
name: GrantPermissions

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user or RAM role
parameters.name: uid

fields.help_en:
The ID of the cluster to be authorized.

If the value of the `role_type` parameter is `all-clusters`, set this parameter to an empty string
fields.help_zh:
授权目标集群ID。

当`role_type`参数的值是`all-clusters`时，此参数的值传空字符串
fields.name: cluster

fields.help_en: Specifies whether the authorization is a custom authorization, which means `role_name` uses a custom ClusterRole name
fields.help_zh: 该授权是否是自定义授权（`role_name`使用自定义的ClusterRole名称）
fields.name: is_custom

fields.help_en: Specifies whether the authorization is for a RAM role
fields.name: is_ram_role

fields.help_en: The namespace name. This parameter is empty by default for cluster-level authorization
fields.help_zh: 命名空间名称，集群维度授权时默认为空
fields.name: namespace

fields.help_en:
The name of the preset role. Valid values:

`admin`: administrator.
`admin-view`: read-only administrator.
`ops`: O&M engineer.
`dev`: developer.
`restricted`: restricted user.
Custom ClusterRole name.

<notice>

`admin`, `admin-view`, `ops`: cannot be granted at the namespace level.
`admin-view`: cannot be granted at the all-clusters level.
</notice>
fields.help_zh:
预置的角色名称，取值：

`admin`: 管理员。
`admin-view`: 只读管理员。
`ops`：运维人员。
`dev`：开发人员。
`restricted`: 受限用户。
自定义的ClusterRole名称。

<notice>

`admin`、`admin-view`、`ops`：不支持命名空间维度的授予。
`admin-view`： 暂不支持所有集群维度的授予。
</notice>
fields.name: role_name

fields.help_en:
The authorization type. Valid values:

`cluster`: cluster level.
`namespace`: namespace level.
`all-clusters`: all-clusters level
fields.help_zh:
授权类型，取值：

`cluster`：集群维度。
`namespace`: 命名空间维度。
`all-clusters`: 所有集群维度
fields.name: role_type
